source_caption:
And it's really one of the most unforgettable one. 

Jim Carrey (Truman Burbank) and Ed Harris (Christof) - the film's main characters - never actually met during the entire production of The Truman Show (1998). Despite their deep emotional connection on screen, all their interactions were filmed separately.
